critical_code_review_comments: Coupons.jsx is 426 lines and mixes upload UI, filters, three tabs — still within the 700-line guideline but growing; consider extracting InventoryTab / AllCouponsTab / IssuedTab and a useCoupons hook to keep future changes safe.

The CSV upload UX uses window.confirm with 'OK = Dry-run, Cancel = Live' which is fragile and easy to mis-click (accidentally hitting Cancel/Enter runs a live import). Recommend replacing with an explicit shadcn dialog offering two buttons: 'Dry-run' and 'Import now'.
loadAll() calls three endpoints sequentially inside a single try; a failure in inventory throws before issued/list load. Prefer Promise.all so one slow/failing endpoint doesn't block the others.

GET /admin/coupons/list is fetched with limit=5000 client-side and further sliced/filtered in-memory — for larger deployments push search/brand/status/pageSize down to the backend query params (they are already supported).
handle401 helper is duplicated across pages (Coupons, likely Staff); consider extracting to a shared axios/fetch wrapper in App.js.
